G=load(); print(sorted(G))

# Find vertical and horizontal segments, then intersections

def find_segments(threshold=2):
    """Find all vertical and horizontal segments with duration >= threshold"""
    rows = len(test)
    cols = len(test[0])
    
    # Vertical segments
    vertical = set()
    for c in range(cols):
        # Find all consecutive sequences
        i = 0
        while i < rows:
            if test[i][c] != 0:
                start = i
                end = i
                while end + 1 < rows and test[end + 1][c] != 0:
                    end += 1
                if end - start + 1 >= threshold:
                    vertical.update((r, c) for r in range(start, end + 1))
                i = end + 1
            else:
                i += 1
    
    # Horizontal segments
    horizontal = set()
    for r in range(rows):
        # Find all consecutive sequences
        i = 0
        while i < cols:
            if test[r][i] != 0:
                start = i
                end = i
                while end + 1 < cols and test[r][end + 1] != 0:
                    end += 1
                if end - start + 1 >= threshold:
                    horizontal.update((r, c) for c in range(start, end + 1))
                i = end + 1
            else:
                i += 1
    
    return vertical, horizontal
